definitions.explanation: A person from another country, especially as seen from a Japanese perspective. More casual and sometimes considered less polite than the formal equivalent.
Someone who does not belong to a particular group or community.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{外人|がいじん}だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{外人|がいじん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: Many foreigners live in this town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|なが}く→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{住|す}んでいて→住む：00673_sumu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{外人|がいじん}⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even after living in Japan for a long time, you can sometimes be treated as a foreigner.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{外人|がいじん}だ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: I'm an outsider in that industry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}れば→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{私|わたし}たち→私たち：28351_watashitachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{外人|がいじん}だ。
examples.english: From the locals' point of view, we are outsiders.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{外人|がいじん}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧わからない。
examples.english: I'm an outsider to the world of politics, so I don't know the details.

notes:
⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (outside) + ⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ (person). Shortened form of ⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧. Very commonly used in everyday speech but can carry a distancing or othering nuance that some find insensitive. In formal writing and official contexts, ⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧ is always preferred.

USAGE:
While not inherently a slur, {外人|がいじん} is perceived by many non-Japanese residents as exclusionary. The word tends to draw a sharp line between Japanese and non-Japanese and can feel reductive. Awareness of this nuance has grown, and many Japanese speakers now prefer ⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧ or ⟦{外国|がいこく}→外国：02868_gaikoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ in polite contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外人|がいじん}⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧ — being treated as a foreigner
- {外人|がいじん}⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧ — foreign player (in sports)
- {外人|がいじん}⟦{部隊|ぶたい}→部隊：28119_butai⟧ — foreign legion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧ — foreigner — the standard, neutral term
- ⟦{異邦人|いほうじん}→異邦人：24100_ihoujin⟧ — stranger from a foreign land — literary and poetic
- {外来者|がいらいしゃ} — outsider; person from outside — formal, often used for visitors
